# qualfi

> qualfi builds bespoke, branded 60-second diagnostic micro-tools for fitness coaches and personal trainers, replacing dead Linktrees, static Google Forms, and passive "DM me READY" calls-to-action with instant personalized calorie/macro deliverables, 0–100 algorithmic lead pre-qualification, and <2s WhatsApp lead routing.

## Core Capabilities
- **60-Second Interactive Value Exchange**: Calculates calibrated Mifflin-St Jeor daily caloric targets (TDEE/BMR), macronutrient breakdowns (protein, carbs, fats in grams), and optimal training splits (Push·Pull·Legs, Upper/Lower, Full Body) in real time.
- **0–100 Algorithmic Lead Pre-Qualification**: Automatically scores every prospect on purchase intent based on coaching goal, training availability, primary obstacle, and commitment timeline.
- **Instant <2s WhatsApp Lead Routing**: Dispatches high-intent verified leads directly to the coach's WhatsApp or phone within 2 seconds while buyer motivation is at its peak.
- **72-Hour Custom Build & Turnaround**: Designed, branded, and deployed as a standalone social bio link (`qualfi.com/@handle`) or website embed within 72 hours.
